basics.name: Yifan Jing（敬益凡）
basics.summary: I want to build open AI systems that work alongside scientists to ask new questions and make discoveries others can verify.

work.summary: Research with Prof. Zhuang Liu on collaboration between image generators and vision-language models.
highlights: Compare answers with and without generated images to identify when image generation helps visual reasoning.

work.summary: Developed HintFlow with Prof. Lei Ying.
highlights: Trained a 4B model to guide frozen 14B–20B reasoning models with short hints. Evaluated the collaboration on math, ARC, and coding tasks.

work.summary: Advised by Grant Barkley, Postdoctoral Assistant Professor of Mathematics.
highlights: Developed algorithms to compare orders through their inversion sets and compute joins using weighted paths. Released the SageMath implementation, TITO_Explore, with my coauthors.
Our paper is under review at FPSAC 2027.

work.summary: Built two mathematical reasoning tasks from combinatorics research.
highlights: Cambrian projection in Lean 4 was merged into the main benchmark. Reviewers designated TITO weak-order comparison for Lite.

work.summary: Robotics research with Prof. Shai Revzen.
highlights: Ran long MuJoCo simulations for Contact Sensing Hexapod. Studying how neural networks and finite-state controllers guide six-legged robots over rough terrain.

work.summary: Compared Transformer, Mamba, and hybrid architectures on associative recall with Samet Oymak.

publications.name: Manuscript on image generation for visual reasoning
Computing Tools for Translation-Invariant Total Orders
publications.publisher: arXiv preprint · Under review at FPSAC 2027
publications.summary: Yifan Jing, Emma Yicheng Lou, Shaotian Sun, and Yuxuan Wu. Algorithms for comparing translation-invariant total orders and computing their joins.

teaching.description: Taught Java in recitations and office hours for a class of more than 125 students, and helped design and grade exams.

portfolio.name: Disproving a second-order converse conjecture for pure-loss channels
portfolio.description: With Yue Tu, disproved the proposed bound using fixed-photon codes and verified the disproof in Lean 4.
